name: @plurnk/plurnk-grammar
description: ANTLR4 grammar for the Plurnk LLM agent protocol

scripts.build:grammar: antlr-ng -D language=TypeScript -o src/generated --generate-visitor true --generate-listener false plurnkLexer.g4 plurnkParser.g4 && node scriptify/fix-generated-imports.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:grammar && npm run build:types && npm run build:dist && npm run build:gbnf
scripts.test:all: npm run test:lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:intg && npm run test:demo
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run deps:fresh && npm audit && npm run build && npm run test:all && npm run test:smoke
